about: Himatsingka Seide Ltd. is a vertically integrated global textile major that designs, develops, manufactures and distributes a suite of home textile products. It has installed capacities for manufacturing bedding and bath products, drapery and upholstery fabrics, and fine-count cotton yarn which are among the largest in the world. [1]
